overview: This one-sentence Senate resolution formally tells the President that the Senate has chosen Jackie Barber as Secretary of the Senate. The Secretary of the Senate is the chamber's chief administrative officer, who oversees its record keeping, legislative clerks, and finances. Notifying the President is a routine courtesy at the start of each Congress or whenever a new Secretary is chosen. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on January 3, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a standard step that keeps the President officially informed of who runs the Senate's day-to-day operations.
against: Critics say the resolution is purely procedural and does not change any law or spending.
